Setup

How It Works

Pair directly in seconds using native Bluetooth HID protocols.

1

1. Turn on Bluetooth

Enable Bluetooth on your Android phone and the target computer (Windows, macOS, Linux) or Android TV.

2

2. Pair Your Device

Open Remote Mouse Jiggler and tap to pair. Your computer recognizes your phone as a standard Bluetooth mouse & keyboard.

3

3. Ready to Control & Jiggle

Use touchpad navigation, media shortcuts, or toggle the automated Jiggler to keep your session alive.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to install any software on my computer or TV?

No! Remote Mouse Jiggler uses the standard Bluetooth Human Interface Device (HID) protocol. Your operating system (Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS) detects it as a standard wireless hardware mouse and keyboard.

Can it be detected as automated software by company monitoring tools?

To the connected PC/Mac, input arrives over standard Bluetooth hardware signals identical to physical wireless mouse hardware. There is no background software or driver installed on the PC.

Does Remote Mouse Jiggler collect any personal data?

Zero data. The app operates completely locally and does not request or require internet permissions. No telemetry, no ads, and no external tracking.

Can I use my phone's gyroscope as a laser pointer / air mouse?

Yes, you can enable gyroscope sensor control in the settings to move your computer mouse cursor by simply moving your phone in the air.
